• CHERRY FLAVORED FROSTING: A delicious artificially flavored cherry frosting; Goes great with baked goods such as cakes, cupcakes, and cookies

  • QUICK AND EASY: Just pop open the can, spread the frosting, and enjoy

  • A TRUSTED FAVORITE: This Betty Crocker frosting is the perfect base for sprinkles and other fun decorations; Try our frosting with other trusted favorites such as Betty Crocker Cake Mix or Brownie Mix

  • GLUTEN FREE: This gluten free frosting is an ideal pantry staple; Keep this Betty Crocker frosting on hand with baking supplies for your impromptu baking needs

  • CONTAINS: One 16 oz tub of Betty Crocker Rich and Creamy Artificially Flavored Cherry Frosting

  • BOX TOPS FOR EDUCATION PARTICIPATING PRODUCT: Give back to schools with Betty Crocker; Download the Box Tops App to learn more & start earning cash for your school or a school in need
features: Enjoy a vibrant burst of cherry flavor with this rich and creamy frosting that’s perfect for topping cakes, cupcakes, and cookies. Certified gluten‑free, it’s ideal for families managing gluten sensitivities or celiac disease. The frosting is ready to use straight from the jar—just open and spread for quick, hassle‑free dessert prep. Its smooth texture and delicious taste make it a convenient pantry staple, whether you’re decorating for a special occasion or whipping up everyday treats. Plus, it’s produced by a trusted brand with over a century of baking expertise
ingredients: Sugar, High Fructose Corn Syrup, Palm Oil, Corn Starch, Water. Contains 2% or less of: Salt, Monoglycerides, Polysorbate 60, Sodium Stearoyl Lactylate, Sodium Acid Pyrophosphate, Artificial Flavor, Citric Acid, Red 40, Blue 2. Freshness Preserved by Potassium Sorbate.
